BIR RAGHAB MORAN
GOVERNMENT MODEL
COLLEGE, DOOMDOOMA
Established in 2020

Rupai Siding, Tinsukia- 786153, Assam, India
    VISION AND MISSION

Vision

To provide affordable, quality and inclusive education for all students. To discover hidden talents, stress on
all-round development of students by providing an enabling environment for realizing their potential and
sculpting them into future leaders, entrepreneurs and above all, a socially productive citizen and a good
human being.

Mission

• To strive for quality and inclusive education


• To transform the college into an institution of educational excellence


• To provide an environment for holistic development of students with special emphasis on social
empowerment and economic self-sufficiency.


• To impart knowledge and learning in a manner that helps transform students into good human beings with
a sense of social responsibility.


• To foster a learning community in which the diverse values, goals, and learning styles of all students are
recognized and supported.


• To motivate our students towards professional/vocational endeavours and serve them with a comfortable
platform where they can explore their talents in their respective fields of interest


• To inculcate values of discipline, hard-work, team-spirit, scientific tempers and to develop critical thinkers.


• Entering into alliances with industry and academic partners to enhance the college’s educational as well as
vocational and career opportunities


• Encouraging students for participation in academic along with extracurricular activities
 Bir Raghab Moran

In the annals of medieval Assam history, among all the notable personalities, the name of Bir Raghab Moran
is always remembered for his courage, bravery, leadership, and sacrifices for the sake of the Assamese
proletariats. He played a very significant role in the Moamaria Rebellion during the reign of Swargadeo
Laksmi Singha which was a spontaneous outburst of simmering discontentment against the exploitative
nature of the Ahom regime. In various circumstances, Raghab Moran alias Raghab Neog himself faced a
number of discriminations and hardships from the authoritarian Ahom administration. Kirtichandra
Barbarua’s physical torture and assault not only made him angry but also the entire Moamaria sect was
thereby insulted. Besides, the religious policies adopted by the contemporary Ahom rulers posed a great
challenge to the Moamarias. It made the entire Moamaria sect discontent and there grew a sense of hatred
and dissension against the Ahom rule.

In this regard, Raghab Neog along with his friends and followers, remaining at the forefront organized and
united the Moamarias against the mighty Ahom rulers to take revenge with a view to establish the
Moamarias in a legitimate position in the feudal Ahom society. Subsequently, the Ahom rulers were bound
to bow down to them which ultimately gave birth to the Muttock Kingdom. From this point of view, Bir
Raghab Moran who used to be a popular leader from the Moran Community among the Moamarias, is still a
hero not only in the minds of the Moran community and Vaishnavite Moamaria sect but also among all those
who are looked down upon as downtrodden and ignorant in the entire Assamese Society. He remains in the
hearts and minds of Assamese people as one the most remarkable cultural and historic luminaries of
Assamese socio-cultural life.
 COLLEGE PROFILE

Bir Raghab Moran Government Model College, Doomdooma was established by the Government of Assam
on 7th March, 2020. With the central aim of improving access, quality, and fostering equity in the higher
education scenario of Assam, the Government of Assam, in consonance with the centrally sponsored scheme
of Model Degree Colleges, set about this enterprising journey of creating educational institutions catering to
the higher education needs of underserved regions. Based on a nationwide survey of Gross Enrollment Ratio
(GER) or Gross Enrollment Index (GEI), Educationally Backward Districts (EBDs) were identified—
districts where GER remained below the national average. Tinsukia is one among the 12 EBDs identified in
Assam. Our college stands today as a successful manifestation of this spirited initiative of the Government
of Assam.



In the more local context, our college has been instrumental in assuaging the severely disproportionate
student-to-higher-education-institution ratio prevailing in the Doomdooma region. It is noteworthy that the
name of the college, “Bir Raghab Moran Government Model College”, holds immense cultural and
historical significance for the inhabitants of this region and Assam at large. In essence, the college name
serves as a tribute to and immortalizes Bir Raghab Moran, a historic pride and son of the soil from the
Moran community—an eminent cultural figure and historical luminary of Assamese socio-cultural life.

The cultural and demographic landscape of the region has deeply influenced the formation of our
institutional vision, mission, and ideals. Culturally, the area features a rich intermix of ethnicities and
traditions, inspiring our commitment to inclusive education and upholding the spirit of unity in diversity.
This location also offers the institution a vibrant platform to showcase and nurture indigenous cultural
knowledge among its students. Given the industrial predominance of the tea sector and a growing inclination
towards entrepreneurship among students, the college prioritizes offering scientific, technical, and skill-
based training that can equip youth with the capabilities to realize their dreams.

Although the college’s initial rationale was to rectify the imbalance in higher education access, our vision
today extends beyond that goal. Alongside fulfilling the fundamental higher education needs of this region,
our grand aspiration is to materialize academic excellence and build a state-of-the-art institution that will
attract meritorious students from across the state. We aim to reverse the prevailing trend of educational brain
drain and instead establish the college as a hub of academic vitality and opportunity.

Despite being a recently established institution, it is a matter of great pride that regular official UG classes
began on 21st December 2020, with a high rate of student enrollment. While the classes are presently
conducted within a temporary arrangement at Doomdooma College, efforts by the Government of Assam are
underway to establish a permanent campus with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including spacious, tech-
enabled classrooms, a modern library, and ample recreational and co-curricular facilities. Bir Raghab Moran
Government Model College began its academic journey with a Three-Year Degree Programme (Honours) in
Arts and a Three-Year Degree Programme (Non-Honours) in Arts, both under the Choice-Based Credit
System (CBCS) affiliated to Dibrugarh University. Despite challenges posed by the COVID-19 second wave,
the college swiftly adapted by organizing virtual classes and sustaining a vibrant culture of webinars, online
competitions, and student-led programmes—a testament to our institutional resilience.



Now, in alignment with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, the college has adopted the Four-Year
Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) as introduced by Dibrugarh University, further expanding the horizon
of academic opportunity and flexibility for students.The college currently houses 8 departments: Education,
Assamese, English, Sociology, History, Political Science, Economics, and Mathematics. The faculty
comprises individuals with strong academic backgrounds, teaching experience, and research contributions,
as well as diverse skills including leadership, cultural engagement, music, and artistic excellence.
 Our students are enterprising and driven, and even as the first cohort, they have exhibited remarkable
enthusiasm, talent, and a deep commitment to learning—despite most of them coming from economically
modest backgrounds. Their passion and untapped potential are central to our growth as an institution.We, the
collective community of students, faculty, and local stakeholders, are committed to building this college into
an institution of excellence, fostering educational access, socio-economic empowerment, and holistic
development. Our shared vision is to transform this region into an educational hub, ensuring that the youth
of Doomdooma and beyond receive not just education, but also the skills and opportunities for self-
sufficiency and dignified living.
 Principal’s Message




                                              Dr. Amorjit Saikia

                                Principal, Bir Raghab Moran Governemnt

                                        Model College, Doomdooma



Bir Raghab Moran Government Model College, Doomdooma, a novel educational institution of higher
education under the initiative of the Government of Assam, affiliated to Dibrugarh University.

Bir Raghab Moran Government Model College, Doomdooma, in essence, is an accomplishment of the
government’s vision of enhancing quality, accessibility, and equity in the higher education scenario of
Assam. Tinsukia, falling within the parameters of an educationally underperforming district of the state of
Assam, urgently was in need of an additional higher education institution to cater to the educational needs of
the local student population. Our college is a very timely and necessary step in this direction.

The true purpose and rationale of this newly established college can be understood better through the
region’s socio-cultural and educational background story. Doomdooma boasts of a culturally rich and
diverse social fabric and a prolific scene of industrial and entrepreneurial activities; but at the same time the
region also suffers from the perennial issues of socio-economic backwardness and most importantly, the
dearth of higher education opportunities for eligible and aspiring students. Under the circumstances, the
establishment of our college has been nothing short of a blessing for the local student population and the
society, in general.

The first academic session (2020–21) of the college formally commenced from 21st December 2020, and
now here we are, steadily progressing toward the sixth academic session (2025–26). The journey so far,
although brief, has been indeed fruitful. Come what may, our staff along with students have been very
resilient. More than half of the time period of our maiden academic session had to be run from our homes
due to the Covid-induced lockdown. We have not shied away from our duties. Our teachers have provided
regular, interactive virtual classes to students and even managed quite successfully, the conduction of extra-
curricular activities (contests, celebration of events, webinars etc). We had encountered a healthy admission
rate and student turnout in the first ever round of admissions and with great confidence, we expect an
equally exuberant student response in this round of admissions in the ongoing session (2024–25). Within a
short span of time, we have discovered diverse talents and skillsets among our students and their enthusiasm
and willingness towards learning and education remains unmatched.
 While education is our primary focus, given the underprivileged socio-economic position of the families that
our students mostly belong to, we shall also strive to provide them an enabling environment for their
positive transformation into social capital such that, they can live free from economic insecurity and
function as productive members of the society. Therefore, along with academic training, we try to motivate
our students into professional endeavours and serve them with a comfortable platform where they can
explore their talents in their respective fields of interest. To this end, our agenda for the near future
incorporates collaborative engagements with government/non-government organizations, industries
surrounding the theme of vocational empowerment of students.

Widely known as the tea city, Doomdooma prides itself on a sprawling tea industry and an aesthetic
atmosphere of tea plantation to an extent that the occupational mainstay of the local population is majorly
within this sector. The youth here, in this sense, is deemed rather naturally inclined towards the tea sector.
We perceive this as an untapped reserve of entrepreneurial potential. Bearing this in mind, we aspire to
provide a facilitative platform aiming at inculcating the right scientific and technical knowhow and skill-
based training to the youth. Futuristically, such a step would be conducive for the students to gainfully and
effectively engage in the niche tea market of the region. The vision is to professionally sculpt them in a
manner so that, they can uplift the indigenous tea sector to the heights of international market efficiency and
competition.

From a broader perspective, our institution’s vision also incorporates the promotion of a participatory model
of all-round educational and social development of the region, involving stakeholders from all quarters with
the intention of eventually, infusing a scientific temperament in and widening the mindsets and worldviews
of the youth and by extension, the society as a whole.

As the founding head of this new institution, I bear a profound sense of obligation towards the youth and the
society of this region. The entire Bir Raghab Moran Government Model College family, as a matter of fact,
collectively shares the dream of transforming the region to a blossoming educational hub and resolve to
spare no effort to ensure the youth here, a brighter future not only in terms of education but also, in terms of
socio-economic empowerment and self-sufficiency.

In this context, it is a moment of great institutional pride to note that the college has now adopted the Four-
Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) as per the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, under the
academic framework of Dibrugarh University, thereby expanding academic opportunities and flexibility for
our students.

 ADMISSION PROCEDURE

In line with the new scheme of Four Year Under Graduate Programmes (FYUGP) under National Education
Policy, 2020 for the academic session 2025–26 under Dibrugarh University guidelines, Bir Raghab Moran
Government Model College, Doomdooma is conducting its admission process through the SAMARTH
Portal mandated by the Government of Assam.

URL: https://assamshesp.samarth.edu.in/index.php/site/login




RESERVATION OF SEATS

There is a provision for reservation of seats, as per the Government of Assam rules and Dibrugarh
University regulations, for candidates belonging to the State of Assam.




GENERAL INFORMATION TO STUDENTS

Students’ Code of Conduct

It is obligatory for all students to wear the prescribed college uniform.

All forms of ragging in the college campus are strictly prohibited. Strong disciplinary action will be
taken against those involved in such activities.

All powers of maintenance of discipline are vested with the Head of the Institution, and his decision
shall be final in such matters.

Students must carry their college identity cards at all times inside the college campus. In case of its loss
or damage, the college authority should be informed immediately.

Students must be regular and punctual in attending classes.

Smoking and chewing of tobacco are strictly prohibited inside the college campus.

Cleanliness of the college campus must be maintained at all times.

Unruly and inappropriate behaviour in and around the college campus will be dealt with seriously.
